fails_if: `_compile_thin_register` stops intersecting the variable's bounds with its variant's (for example takes the earliest start), so COL's state is not 2010-01-01..2018-12-31

sources.description: Authored FK register r (2000-2020), variant v (2010-2018), variable COL (2005-2019). Plus the SCB sample.

files.Forsakringskassan/fk.toml:
[[register]]
key = "r"
name = "R"
valid_from = "2000-01-01"
valid_to = "2020-12-31"
[[register.variant]]
key = "v"
name = "V"
valid_from = "2010-01-01"
valid_to = "2018-12-31"
[[register.variable]]
name = "Col"
column = "COL"
data_type = "int"
variants = ["v"]
valid_from = "2005-01-01"
valid_to = "2019-12-31"
